description: This is a unit test class for the ImmutableJsonBoolean class, testing its immutability, equality, and behavior of true and false constants.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonLiteralTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the behavior and immutability of ImmutableJsonBoolean

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that ImmutableJsonBoolean instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the equals and hashCode contract for ImmutableJsonBoolean, including handling of SoftReference comparisons.

methods.name: trueBehavesAsExpected
methods.description: Asserts that ImmutableJsonBoolean.TRUE behaves as a boolean true literal, not an array, object, number, or string.

methods.name: falseBehavesAsExpected
methods.description: Asserts that ImmutableJsonBoolean.FALSE behaves as a boolean false literal, not an array, object, number, or string.
